# [Refund / cancellation / downgrade policy](https://forum.newsblur.com/t/refund-cancellation-downgrade-policy/13802)


[question](https://forum.newsblur.com/c/question/8)


[slowwalk](https://forum.newsblur.com/u/slowwalk)


August 12, 2026, 12:42pm 1


I’m interested in becoming a paying member but $99 seems a bit steep without seeing the Archive capabilities first. In the FAQ i saw some items about upgrading but nothing about downgrading or cancelling. I saw some forum posts from around 2015 saying the owner is generous with refunds, but I haven’t found any policy about cancellation or getting a refund if not satisfied. Is it possible or would it matter if I subscribe via the app or the App Store? Is there a way to subscribe monthly (lower risk in case I’m not satisfied)?
